title: Video Game Sales Analysis
description: Performed complete exploratory data analysis on a video game sales dataset — from data cleaning through genre, platform, and publisher-level sales trends.
businessProblem: Understand what drives video game sales performance across platforms, genres, and publishers to surface actionable business insights.
workflow: Clean and prepare the raw sales dataset
Handle missing values across platform and publisher fields
Engineer features for trend and regional analysis
Break down performance by genre, platform, and publisher
Run correlation analysis across sales regions
Visualize findings and summarize business insights
results: Action and Sports genres led global sales volume; a small number of publishers accounted for a disproportionate share of top-selling titles.
lessonsLearned: Regional sales columns were highly correlated, which shaped how the correlation analysis was interpreted and presented.
